page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes and no footnotes. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: multa incidas incommoda. primùm peccando in corpus: secundò animam necando: tertiò, opes annihilando. Qui n. nutrit scortum, perdet substantiam, exemplo prodigi filij. Luc. 15. qui dissipauit substantiam suam cum meretricibus viuendo luxuriosè.

Noli circumspicere in vicis ciuitatis, ne oberraueris in plateis illius) vel ne per eius infrequentia loca vagare. Effugere peccata non potest, qui peccandi occasionem non fugit, quas oculus incautior abundè suppeditat, secundum Augustinum: Impudicus oculus impudici cordis est nuncius. Plateas urbium peruagare qui diligit, facilè per inordinatos appetitus aberrabit. Si Dina mansisset domi, non fuisset vitiata à Sichem, Genef. 34. Præstat disciplinam & verecundiam seruare in visu. Sunt enim secundum Senecam oculi irritamenta vitiorum, duces scelerum: huic ministrant oculi adulterium, huic domum, quam concupiscat. Nam ἐκ τῆς ὄψεως[?] γίνεται τὸ [illegible, ~8 letters]. Unde & vetus ille Hebræus: Aspectus (inquit) oculi, initium est praevaricationis. Oculus enim videt, & cor concupiscit: atque instrumenta operis (intellige cordis membra) perficiunt. Hinc Democritus sibi ipsi oculos eruisse scribitur. Hinc ipse quoque Homerus humanioris literaturæ parens, cæcus est. Itaque averte potius oculos, ne videant vanitatem: quemadmodum sequitur:

page.notes: Greek line after "Nam" is only partly legible; the letters after ὄψεως are uncertain and the end of the Greek sentence is illegible. The printed "Auerte" is read as "Averte" under the u/v rule. Long s is printed as f in places ("fecundò", "fuiffet", "eruiffe") and is transcribed as s. The word "fortum" is read as "scortum" from the context. The word "ne" at the bottom right is the catchword, not text. No margin notes are visible; a faint mark at the left margin near "aberrabit" is not printed text. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
